mapper.insert: insert into reservation ( user_id, charger_id, user_vehicle_id, reservation_type, status, reserved_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{chargerId}, #{userVehicleId}, #{reservationType}, 'RESERVED', now() )
insert into reservation_time (reservation_id, start_time, end_time) values (#{id}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
insert into reservation_target (reservation_id, target_kwh, max_minutes) values (#{id}, #{targetKwh}, #{maxMinutes})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.charger_id as chargerId, r.user_vehicle_id as userVehicleId, em.model_name as carType, r.reservation_type as reservationType, r.status, r.reserved_at as reservedAt, r.actual_start_time as actualStartTime, r.actual_end_time as actualEndTime, rt.start_time as startTime, rt.end_time as endTime, tgt.target_kwh as targetKwh, tgt.max_minutes as maxMinutes from reservation r left join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id left join reservation_target tgt on r.id = tgt.reservation_id left join user_vehicle uv on r.user_vehicle_id = uv.id left join ev_model em on uv.model_id = em.id where r.id = #{reservationId}

select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.charger_id as chargerId, r.user_vehicle_id as userVehicleId, em.model_name as carType, r.reservation_type as reservationType, r.status, r.reserved_at as reservedAt, rt.start_time as startTime, rt.end_time as endTime, tgt.target_kwh as targetKwh, tgt.max_minutes as maxMinutes from reservation r left join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id left join reservation_target tgt on r.id = tgt.reservation_id left join user_vehicle uv on r.user_vehicle_id = uv.id left join ev_model em on uv.model_id = em.id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.id desc
mapper.update: update reservation set status = 'CHARGING', actual_start_time = now() where id = #{reservationId}
update reservation set status = 'COMPLETED', actual_end_time = now() where id = #{reservationId}
update reservation set status = 'CANCELED' where id = #{reservationId}
update reservation r join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id set r.status = 'EXPIRED' where r.status = 'RESERVED' and rt.end_time < now()
mapper.select: select id, station_id as stationId, connector_type as connectorType, power_kw as powerKw, status from charger order by id asc
/* ReservationMapper.getSidoList : DB에서 실제 등록된 시/도 목록 추출 */ SELECT DISTINCT metro FROM station WHERE metro IS NOT NULL AND metro != '' ORDER BY metro ASC
select id, station_id as stationId, connector_type as connectorType, power_kw as powerKw, status from charger where station_id = #{stationId} order by id asc

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.login_id AS loginId, r.charger_id AS chargerId, c.connector_type AS connectorType, s.name AS stationName, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, r.user_vehicle_id AS userVehicleId, em.model_name AS carType, r.reserved_at AS reservedAt, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, tgt.target_kwh AS targetKwh, tgt.max_minutes AS maxMinutes FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id LEFT JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target tgt ON r.id = tgt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN user_vehicle uv on r.user_vehicle_id = uv.id LEFT JOIN ev_model em on uv.model_id = em.id
AND r.status = #{searchStatus}
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(r.id) AS totalChargeCount, COALESCE(SUM(rt.target_kwh), 0) AS totalChargeKw, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(rt.target_kwh), 0) * 0.42, 1) AS savedCarbon FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_target rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED'
